enabled.label: Import a product from a link
enabled.help: Paste a supplier's or brand's product page and get a draft product to finish. It never goes on the shop by itself.

allowedHosts.label: Sites a link may come from
allowedHosts.help: Only pages on these sites can be read (one host per line, such as shop.example.com). Empty = any public site.

maxPageKb.label: Largest page to read (KB)
maxPageKb.help: A bigger page is refused, so a wrong link cannot slow the server down.

timeoutSeconds.label: Time to wait for a page (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.help: After this the reading stops and you can try again.

maxRedirects.label: Forwarding steps to follow
maxRedirects.help: How many times a link may forward to another address before the reading stops.

maxImages.label: Photos to list from a page
maxImages.help: The photo links found on the page, shown for you to look at. Photos are not copied: upload your own.

useAi.label: Let AI tidy the draft
useAi.help: When AI is switched on and connected, it tidies the name and description. Without AI the draft is made by plain rules.

enabled.label: "Tell me when it is back" on sold-out pages
enabled.help: A sold-out or hidden product keeps its page; customers can leave a phone number or e-mail to hear when it is back.

channels.label: How customers can ask to be told

callingCode.label: Country calling code for phone numbers
callingCode.help: A number typed without + gets this code (01… becomes +880 1…).

maxPerContactPerDay.label: Requests per phone or e-mail per day
maxPerContactPerDay.help: More than this from one phone number or e-mail in a day is refused, so the list stays clean.

alternatives.label: Similar products shown on a sold-out page
alternatives.help: In-stock products from the same category shown under a sold-out product. 0 = none.

staleDays.label: Check products again after (days)
staleDays.help: The audit report checks a product again when its last check is older than this.

recheckMax.label: Products checked again per opening
recheckMax.help: At most this many products are checked again each time the report opens, so it stays quick. The rest follow next time.
